title: One-third stable influence bound
statement: Let $n\\in\\mathbb N$, let $f:\\{0,1\\}^n\\to\\mathbb R$ take values in $\\{-1,1\\}$, and let $i\\in[n]$. Then $I_i^{(1/3)}(f)\\le\\mathrm{Inf}_i(f)^{3/2}$, where $I_i^{(1/3)}(f)=\\sum_{S\\ni i}(1/3)^{|S|-1}\\widehat f(S)^2$ and $\\mathrm{Inf}_i(f)=\\mathbb E[(f(x)-f(x^i))^2/4]$ under the uniform cube measure.
replaced: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube and $i\in[n]$. Then $I_i^{(1/3)}(f)\le I_i(f)^{3/2}$. For a real cube function $h$, define $I_i(h)=\tfrac14\mathbb E_x(h(x)-h(x^{(i)}))^2$, where $x^{(i)}$ flips coordinate $i$ and $\mathbb E_x$ is uniform expectation.
